archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) mixed with Technical/Terminal Luxury

core_principles: Typing as Flow State: The arena must be utterly devoid of distractions. Maximum focus on the center.
Terminal Luxury: Deepest black backgrounds (LCH-inspired) with high-contrast text and subtle glassmorphic elements. No pure black #000000, use #09090B.
Data as Art: Post-session analytics must look like high-end fintech dashboards, prioritizing density and clarity.
design_philosophy.vibe: Monkeytype focus meets Linear's elevated dark mode and Raycast's snappy utility.

scales.typing_text: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl leading-relaxed tracking-normal font-mono
scales.label: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500

layout.typing_container: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-center

buttons.primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-sans font-medium px-6 py-3 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-blue-500/50 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(59,130,246,0.1)]
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-white font-sans px-6 py-3 rounded-lg border border-white/10 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.bento_base: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-6 transition-all hover:border-white/10
cards.stat_card: flex flex-col gap-2 bg-zinc-900/30 border border-white/5 p-6 rounded-xl

inputs.base: bg-zinc-900/50 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 focus:border-blue-500/50 transition-all font-sans

typing_arena.caret: w-0.5 h-8 bg-blue-500 animate-pulse absolute transition-all duration-75

motion.caret_animation: Use Framer Motion to smoothly translate the caret x/y position behind/under the current letter.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion initial={opacity: 0, y: 10} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0} transition={duration: 0.3}
motion.stagger_children: For dashboard cards and stats grid.

images.description: Dark abstract dynamic tunnel effect in blue tones, conveying motion and depth. Use with a heavy opacity overlay (bg-zinc-950/80).
Abstract neon lines forming a digital landscape. Use for authentication page backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'IBM Plex Mono' (or similar mono font) for the typing arena text and main headings. Use 'Inter' for UI text.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use Tailwind zinc-950 (#09090B) for the root background.
The Typing Arena should dominate the screen. Remove all sidebars and distractions during an active test (Monkeytype style).
Use framer-motion for the typing caret to ensure it glides character-by-character smoothly.
For the post-session stats, implement recharts with dark mode styling (no grid lines, subtle stroke colors).
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
Use Lucide React for minimal, monoline icons.
The AI Mistake Analysis should look like a code-review diff or a technical terminal output.
Forms (login/signup) must use custom styled Shadcn components, stripped of light mode defaults.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure untyped text (zinc-600) meets contrast against zinc-950 background (aprox 4.5:1). Active text is white.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 on all focusable inputs and buttons.
